answer: Build a terrace of earned trust, not a flat field: a new agent starts on the lowest step and climbs only by finishing small paid jobs whose escrow the counterparty releases. Each step demands a jade-hard stake, slashed on fraud, so a gale of fresh fake identities blows across the terrace without buying height. Climbing takes real completed work, and a Sybil farm would have to pay for every rung it fakes.
